about: Agent connect step 7.9, the agent chat (docs/plans/agent-connect-plan.md §3.5, §6): the chat (frame 27), stopped at 20 with no reply and not connected (frame 28), and the version mismatch (no frame). Same form as agent-connect-screens.json, which the catalogue (screenCatalogue.test.tsx) reads with this file; the drawings are __tests__/fixtures/screenStatesChat.tsx. Reached from Messages and from an agent's details, with the developer switch on.
